decks.title: The 12 cranial nerves
decks.intro: Type the name of each cranial nerve.

items.clue: CN I – smell
CN II – vision
CN III – most eye muscles, pupil constriction
CN IV – superior oblique
CN V – sensation of the face, muscles of mastication
CN VI – lateral rectus
CN VII – muscles of facial expression
CN VIII – hearing and balance
CN IX – stylopharyngeus, taste of the posterior third of the tongue
CN X – parasympathetic supply to thoracic and abdominal organs
CN XI – sternocleidomastoid and trapezius
CN XII – muscles of the tongue
